2. Coordinator confirms Registry is stable after deploy.
3. Set ALPHA_REPLICATION_CARD_ADMISSION_ENABLED=1 in the dev env and recreate alpha-replication-worker; watch exactly one tick: Registry memory and the view=card_admission_drafts request count/bytes.
4. Leave on only if Registry stays well below 256 MiB; turn off by setting it back to 0 and recreating the worker.
